entities.summary: Yevgeny Viktorovich Belousov, better known as Zhenya Belousov was a Soviet and Russian pop singer, popular in the late 1980s – early 1990s. His best-known hits include My Blue-Eyed Girl, Night Taxi, Alyoshka, Devchonka-Devchonochka, Evening-Evening, Hair Cloud, Golden Domes, Short Summer, Dunya-Dunyasha, In the Evening on a Bench.
